title: Baltoro Glacier: 1920 vs 2024
caption: A century of glacial ice loss and lateral moraine expansion along the legendary Baltoro Highway.
observation: Historical black-and-white photogrammetry compared to modern high-resolution imaging demonstrates significant thinning of the ice snout and increasing formation of supraglacial melt lakes.
climateNote: The Karakoram anomaly historically maintained stable ice mass due to intense winter precipitation, but recent accelerated warming has triggered rapid melting below 4,200m.

title: Passu Glacier & Cathedral Spire Recession
caption: Retreat of the Passu White Glacier snout and expansion of the glacial moraine basin near the Karakoram Highway.
observation: The glacier terminus has retreated over 700 meters upstream from the original gravel outwash plain, altering local meltwater irrigation channels relied upon by Passu village farmers.
climateNote: Alpine Ascents practices strict Leave No Trace guidelines to minimize black carbon deposition that accelerates ice ablation.
